title: Recovery from Iterated Extensions
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $w,z$ be finite binary strings. If $z$ is obtained from $w$ by $k$ successive extensions, where each extension replaces a string $u$ by the pair encoding of $u$ and some binary string, then applying the total first projection to $z$ exactly $k$ times returns $w$.
